Senior Associate Analyst - Full Stack

   Summary 
 
● Backend Developer with 4 years of hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using 
Node.js, React Js, Express, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices. 
 
● Proven expertise in architecting RESTful APIs, designing data models, and integrating complex business workflows across 
domains like healthcare, logistics, billing, and subscription platforms. 
● Strong background in legacy system modernization, refactoring decade-old codebases, and rapidly adapting to existing 
architectures to deliver new features efficiently. 
● Experienced in database optimization, including query tuning, indexing strategies, and improving application performance for 
high-transaction systems. 
● Demonstrated ability to own projects end-to-end, from requirement analysis and architecture planning to development, QA, 
deployment, and production-level support. 
● Highly collaborative, proactive problem solver with excellent communication skills, known for delivering projects under tight 
deadlines while maintaining code quality and system reliability.

Professional Experience 
 
Logistics - Dr. Lal PathLabs : 
 
● Contributed to building Logistics Management System for handling transportation of blood samples, cash 
collections, and other critical medical items across network routes. 
 
● Support with Frontend activities.

for high-volume logistics operations.

● Collaborated closely with logistics teams to understand ground-level workflows and translate them into 
efficient backend processes and automated flows. 
 
● Ensured secure data handling and compliance with medical and operational requirements during the 
transportation and tracking of sensitive items. 
 
 
 
Dr. Lal PathLabs : 
 
● Single-handedly developed a new premium brand platform for Dr. Lal PathLabs, delivering a modern and

high-quality delivery within a tight timeline. 
 
● Demonstrated strong ownership by handling requirement analysis, development, testing, optimization, and

Billing Management System : 
 
● Single-handedly architected and developed a full Billing Management System using KeystoneJS, 
covering employees, projects, billing cycles, and reporting workflows. 
 
● Designed and implemented RESTful APIs using Keystone’s schema and relationship model, enabling fast, 
reliable, and scalable data interactions. 
● Leveraged KeystoneJS’s advanced relationship management to build complex data 
structures—supporting project allocations, employee billing, and multi-level approval 
flows. 
 
● Optimized data retrieval through Keystone’s built-in query features, ensuring efficient filtering, pagination, 
and aggregation for large datasets. 
 
● Built secure authentication and role-based access control to streamline operations for admins, managers, 
and employees. 
 
● Delivered the entire solution end-to-end—including database modeling, API architecture, business logic, 
testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 
 
Home Title Lock : 
 
● Led end-to-end data migration, designing secure migration scripts in Node.js and ensuring high data 
integrity for US land-title protection records. 
 
● Built reusable, modular backend components to streamline API development, reduce code duplication, 
and improve maintainability across the platform. 
 
● Implemented payment gateway integrations (e.g., subscriptions, refunds, upgrades/downgrades) with 
robust error handling and idempotent transaction workflows. 
 
● Developed and optimized subscription management services, including automated billing logic, plan 
changes, renewal flows, and customer lifecycle updates. 
 
● Enhanced security measures for user identity, subscription data, and land-registration information to help 
protect US homeowners from title-related fraud. 
 
● Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve system reliability, introduce logging/monitoring, and 
support deployment of new features in production. 
 
 
Value to the Organization: 
● Consistently deliver end-to-end backend solutions—reducing development time, improving system 
performance, and enabling faster release cycles. 
 
● Modernize and optimize legacy systems, improving reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability 
across critical healthcare and logistics platforms. 
 
● Build clean, reusable APIs and optimized data workflows that lower operational costs and enhance 
user experience for both internal teams and end customers.
